scope: Operational interpretation of user95%reference-quality target. Measures evidence-backed compliance with frozen adopted editorial criteria, not pixel/aesthetic similarity95% or factual submission validity.

criteria.requirement: All used scripts resolve to selected face/fallback declarations; final native PDF glyphs show no unexpected substitution or missing glyph.
criteria.observation_unit: each semantically distinct body/header/caption/ID run style and each used Hangul/Latin/numeric/symbol sample

criteria.requirement: Cover, TOC, heading, label, value, identifier and caption have the profile hierarchy, with no ad-hoc size reduction to fit.
criteria.observation_unit: each semantic text-role occurrence and style exception
required_evidence: current HWPX charPr heights and derived-definition report

criteria.requirement: Role-specific line spacing and character spacing/ratio match targets; text remains readable without ink collisions.
criteria.observation_unit: each used paragraph-role definition plus every dense paragraph on original pages
required_evidence: resolved paraPr lineSpacing and charPr spacing/ratio

criteria.requirement: Paragraph separation, indentation and cell padding are consistent within their role and do not create false grouping.
criteria.observation_unit: each semantic paragraph group and repeated cell type
required_evidence: original-page editorial observations with paragraph/cell locator

criteria.requirement: Body orientation/margins/usable width obey the selected profile while cover, controls, page numbers and anchors remain coherent.
criteria.observation_unit: each section boundary and selected body table
required_evidence: actual native PDF page boxes and original pages

criteria.requirement: Logical/physical names, long IDs, type, keys, units and header labels are readable in their columns at final printed size.
criteria.observation_unit: each nonempty data/header cell; long-ID rows are individually inspected
required_evidence: row/column mapping and current cell widths

criteria.requirement: Long IDs and words wrap consistently at declared boundaries without changing, abbreviating or dropping their values.
criteria.observation_unit: each long identifier and each page-boundary word

criteria.requirement: Heading remains with meaningful following content and continuation pages retain table/record identity.
criteria.observation_unit: each heading at page end and each continued card/table boundary

criteria.requirement: White space and density support the role; large empty areas have an explicit editorial reason and are not a layout failure hidden by total page count.
criteria.observation_unit: each physical page and each conspicuous blank region

criteria.requirement: Body explanations and trace records use readable business sentences/specification tables rather than raw JSON/debug strings.
criteria.observation_unit: each requirement/screen/table/program/test/trace or management record
required_evidence: raw JSON token search as auxiliary only

criteria.requirement: Every supplied meaningful field, type, relation, note and source has an explicit document/appendix location or justified nonprinting decision.
criteria.observation_unit: each supplied semantic leaf or relation in input

criteria.requirement: Unknown/null/false/0/empty string, planned/performed and actual claims remain distinct and human-readable.
criteria.observation_unit: each state/type boundary case and its rendered occurrence

criteria.requirement: Same facts, IDs, units, periods, directions and direct trace relations stay consistent across roles without transitive invention.
criteria.observation_unit: each shared fact or explicit relation appearing in two roles

criteria.requirement: Template instructions and required fields remain satisfied; expert conventions, source defects and implementation choices are explicitly distinguished.
criteria.observation_unit: each applicable mandatory instruction and each adopted/excluded convention
required_evidence: profile mandatory locators and source hashes

criteria.requirement: Every supplied or test figure is mapped to a meaningful slot with correct screen/record ID, source hash, caption and declared real/reference/synthetic status.
criteria.observation_unit: each supplied/test figure and each absent-required-figure slot
required_evidence: caption/source text on native original page

criteria.requirement: At final printed size a reader can identify essential screen fields, diagram nodes/arrows and the steps described in the body.
criteria.observation_unit: each essential label/field/node/arrow in each figure
required_evidence: named reviewer observation for each essential element

criteria.requirement: Aspect ratio, crop, display size and placement preserve essential content and keep the figure with its caption/explanation.
criteria.observation_unit: each figure and caption/adjacent-body association

criteria.requirement: Current final bytes were actually opened/saved/closed/reopened/exported in the recorded Hancom version, or explicit8event repair workflow completed.
criteria.observation_unit: each current final HWPX artifact under review

criteria.requirement: Strict styled-before/native-after semantics/formatting and current TOC/page sequence pass; every current PDF page has a matched original PNG and explicit editorial review.
criteria.observation_unit: each strict invariant, TOC entry, printed-page boundary and physical PDF page

criteria.requirement: For the same meaningful content, the improved output meets the adopted reference conventions and excluded source defects are independently explained; heldout output meets the same criteria.
criteria.observation_unit: each preselected comparable content block in same-content and heldout cases
required_evidence: heldout input freeze and named independent observations

score_policy.per_criterion: 100*passed_units/required_observation_units; failed+unknown remain in denominator. Units and applicability frozen from input/profile before output review.
score_policy.per_role: minimum of all applicable criterion pass rates, not a weighted average. Every role must reach95%. Also report pooled counts/rate for transparency.
score_policy.whole_suite: minimum of19 role scores must be>=95%, pooled rate>=95%, and all mandatory gates pass. A strong role cannot compensate a weak role.
score_policy.critical_failure_policy: Any observed critical failure blocks acceptance regardless of rate. A missing/wrong state, lost field, unreadable essential image label, changed ID, missing page, wrong font substitution or stale native evidence is critical.
score_policy.unknown_policy: Unknown/missing evidence never counts as pass; it remains in denominator. Final completion requires zero unknown/unreviewed required units.
score_policy.applicability_policy: No post-hoc exemption to raise score. An inherently absent figure may replace G02/G03 units only with a predeclared absence/required-slot test; provided/required figures may not be removed. Same-content graphic roles require actual reference or clearly labelled synthetic test-figure cases.
score_policy.no_inflation: Do not count every ordinary glyph as a separate easy pass, repeat cover checks to inflate denominator, or split one semantic unit after observing a failure. Unit inventory is fixed and hashed before review.
score_policy.score_without_evidence: Prohibited; all actual counts/rates remain null until current source/output/native/original-image evidence is entered.

independence: Implementation author cannot be the sole final editorial reviewer. Independent evaluation uses the declared environment/inputs outside repository cwd and no hidden paths or author adjustments.
